chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Willard's research; Esquire new star award and recordings with Jacquet and Dizzy
summary: Willard found his name in only a few books; Collins cites his 1946 Esquire new star award and the many records with Jacquet, Gillespie and 52nd Street groups.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press
